title: Lady Susanna Blunt
dates: (1829/30-8 April 1900)
---



She was daughter of the 2nd Earl Nelson, who changed his name from Bolton on succeeding his uncle in 1835, and sister of the 3rd Earl Nelson.

She was therefore related to Alexander Montgomery Moore.

At a fairly advanced age she married (27 June 1865) the Rev.

Canon Alexander Colvin Blunt.

She was the president of the GFS in Winchester diocese in 1878.

Her mother and CMY’s had been friends.  [PB Blunt Bt.

Nelson E]
